name: Comellio
tagline: AI phone receptionist for restaurants in British Columbia
description:
Comellio gives restaurant teams in British Columbia an AI phone receptionist and a shared browser workspace for guest calls, reservations and follow-ups. It is made in North Vancouver and is available for paid restaurant setup.

The receptionist answers routine questions using the restaurant's information. It handles reservations within configured opening hours and table rules, reads booking details back to callers and can use automatic booking or staff approval. If a caller needs a person, the call can transfer to staff. An unanswered transfer creates an assigned follow-up task.

Comellio has its own reservation book. Staff manually copy bookings into OpenTable, Resy, Tock or a POS; native booking writes to those systems are not included. Restaurant-specific configuration, an in-person setup visit and staff briefing are part of the offer.

The Answer plan is CAD 249 per restaurant per month plus tax. Setup is CAD 299, with a waiver when switching from another answering service. Comellio Custom is available by quote.
